articles.title: Binance hacker dumps a little-known 2017 token and it crashes 90%
articles.snippet: The hacker dumped FUN and other smaller tokens into markets too small to absorb large selling, leading to price crashes.

articles.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
articles.snippet: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

articles.title: Zcash grants group offers $124M compromise as governance backlash grows
articles.snippet: Zcash Community Grants proposed redirecting about $124 million in existing and future funding toward mining rewards, but critics say the plan fails to address governance and accountability concerns.
